functionality: Reversible adsorption of a cationic organic pollutant with low expected leaching
targetPollutant: Methylene blue, aqueous concentration range 1–50 mg/L
waterMatrix: Synthetic freshwater with 10 mM NaCl; test separately in secondary wastewater
operatingConditions: Batch screening at pH 6–8, 25 °C, adsorbent dosage 0.1–1.0 g/L, contact time 0–240 min
compatibility: Measure polymer swelling, residual monomer release, regeneration performance, and mass balance
regulatoryCompliance: Document analytical calibration, detection limits, blanks, and relevant local water-treatment requirements
